production.note: Calendar years of customer deliveries of the 24 coupes, as in the Bugatti records (Hennessey publishes no US model years). Quote (Hennessey, 4 July 2023): "The twin-turbocharged, 6.6-liter V8 Venom F5 Coupe sold out in 2021, with customer deliveries taking place from 2021-2023." and "Hennessey introduced the Venom F5 Coupe in December 2020 and all 24 units quickly sold out following its Car Week appearance in 2021." The Roadster, Revolution and F5-M are separate models.

body.note: The Venom F5 Coupe; the open Venom F5 Roadster is sold under its own name.

displacementL.note: "6.6 L"; no cc figure was found on any page opened.

fuel.note: Petrol twin-turbo V8 (no hybrid system described).

drivetrain.note: Motor Authority describes a "mechanical limited-slip rear differential"; Hennessey's Roadster release lists "Rear-wheel drive" for the related Roadster (hennessey-roadster-release).

transmission.note: "CIMA 7-speed single-clutch automated manual transmission"; Hennessey's Roadster release: "7-speed single-clutch automated gearbox".

powerHp.note: Quote (Hennessey Special Vehicles Venom F5 page): "1,817 hp" with "1,193 lb-ft". Hennessey's Roadster release (hennessey-roadster-release): "twin-turbocharged, 6.6-liter, 'Fury' V8 engine rated at an astonishing 1,817 bhp" ("1,817 bhp @ 8,000 rpm"). Hennessey states hp; no SAE certification is stated, so powerStandard is Other.

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: publications, DRY weight (weight-order step 4, but not from the manufacturer or a major magazine). Quote (Robb Report): "The vehicle's tech figures are as eye-catching as its carbon-fiber bodywork and include a zero-to-62 mph time of 2.6 seconds, 1,193 ft lbs of torque and a dry weight of 2,998 pounds." The same 2,998 lb, unlabelled, in Motor Authority (motorauthority-f5, Joel Feder, 15 Dec 2020): "In total, the car weighs 2,998 pounds", and ClassicCars.com Journal (classiccars-f5, Larry Edsall, 15 Dec 2020): "The car weighs 2,998 pounds". All three report the December 2020 reveal. No Hennessey page opened gives a coupe weight (Hennessey's 2023 release gives the Roadster a "curb weight of just over 3,000 pounds"; its 2022 Roadster release gives the Roadster 3,098 lb). No curb weight for the coupe was found.
